picks.title: Observer Metamerism
picks.description: 最近的 `metamerism`、`making-of` 和 `hdr-color-science` 都在把一个很容易被误判成“校准没做好”的问题讲清楚：同样的坐标、同样的白点，在窄峰广色域显示上并不保证所有观察者都看成同一个颜色。这条 ACESCentral 帖子最值得读的地方，是它没有停在概念解释，而是直接把 observer metamerism 放进 BT.2020 激光显示的模拟里，让你看到为什么火焰、霓虹或高饱和高光会在不同人眼里偏黄、偏粉，进而影响显示白点、监看一致性和 output transform 的判断。拿它回看站内最近关于同色异谱失败和新型显示设备章节，会更容易把抽象概念连到真实制作环境。
picks.descriptionEn: The recent `metamerism`, `making-of`, and `hdr-color-science` chapters all unpack a problem that is too often misdiagnosed as bad calibration: identical coordinates and the same nominal white point do not guarantee identical perception across observers on narrow-band wide-gamut displays. The value of this ACESCentral post is that it moves beyond definition and directly simulates observer metamerism on a BT.2020 laser display, making it easier to see why flames, neon, or highly saturated highlights may shift toward yellow or pink for different viewers. It connects the site's recent chapters on metameric failure, display white, and new display technologies back to a real production-monitoring problem.

picks.title: The old vs new “HDR” photography
picks.description: 最近的 `HDR-Relay`、`scene-display-referred` 和 `hdr-color-science` 一直在拆一个常见混淆：以前为了 SDR 屏幕做 tone mapping 的“老 HDR”，和今天依赖更亮显示器再配合 gain map 交付的“真 HDR”，不是同一类东西。这篇文章最值得读的地方，是它把两者差异讲得非常直观：旧流程的核心是把高动态范围压回 SDR 里，新流程的核心则是尽量保住场景里的高光亮度和颜色，再通过兼容编码让 SDR/HDR 同时成立。对理解站内最近为什么要花这么多篇幅讲 gain map、彩色高光恢复和 scene-to-display 渲染，这是一篇很好的外部续读。
picks.descriptionEn: The recent `HDR-Relay`, `scene-display-referred`, and `hdr-color-science` chapters keep separating one persistent confusion: the older SDR-oriented tone-mapped "HDR" and modern true HDR delivered through brighter displays plus gain maps are not the same thing. The value of this article is how concretely it draws that line: the old workflow is about squeezing high dynamic range back into SDR limits, while the new workflow is about preserving highlight brightness and color as much as the display allows, then using a compatible encoding so SDR and HDR viewers can both get an appropriate result. It is a strong external continuation of the site's recent focus on gain maps, colored highlight recovery, and scene-to-display rendering.

picks.title: Edit Ultra HDR images
picks.description: 最近的 `HDR-Relay` 和 `making-of` 都在把一个很容易被忽略的现实问题讲透：HDR gain map 不是导出完就结束，后续裁切、缩放、贴图、滤镜这些编辑动作，会不会把亮度恢复关系一起带坏，决定了最终兼容性。这篇资料最值得读的地方，是它把 gain map 当成工作流里的独立对象来处理，明确区分哪些基础编辑会自动同步 gain map，哪些复杂编辑必须手动重建或修补。对理解站内最近那条“还原算法正确”和“后续交付仍然正确”之间还隔着什么，非常有帮助。
picks.descriptionEn: The recent `HDR-Relay` and `making-of` chapters both push on an easy-to-miss production reality: exporting an HDR gain-map image is not the end, because later crops, resizes, overlays, and filters can silently break the luminance reconstruction relationship. The value of this piece is that it treats the gain map as its own workflow object, clearly separating which basic edits keep it in sync automatically and which more complex edits require you to rebuild or patch it yourself. It is a strong continuation of the site's recent point that a correct reconstruction algorithm does not automatically guarantee a correct downstream delivery workflow.

picks.title: Re-Framing and Clarifying the Goals of an Output Transform
picks.description: 站内最近的 `scene-display-referred`、`hdr-color-science` 和 7 月 6 日那条 gamut mapping 讨论，已经把“输出变换不是单纯压亮度”讲出来了；这条讨论更进一步，把高光该不该更快往白走、去饱和到底是技术约束还是创作风格、以及什么才算在有限峰值亮度下保住‘亮感’，直接摊开辩论。它最值得读的地方，不是给一个唯一答案，而是让读者看到 output transform 真正在权衡什么，这对理解站内最近关于 path-to-white、highlight chroma compression 和 display-referred 观感设计的章节尤其有延伸价值。
picks.descriptionEn: The recent `scene-display-referred`, `hdr-color-science`, and the July 6 gamut-mapping pick already make the point that an output transform is not just a luminance squeeze. This discussion goes one layer deeper by openly debating whether highlights should move toward white more aggressively, whether desaturation is a technical constraint or a creative choice, and what it really means to preserve a sensation of brightness on displays with limited peak luminance. Its value is not a single answer, but exposing what an output transform is actually balancing, which makes it a strong continuation of the site's recent chapters on path-to-white, highlight chroma compression, and display-referred look design.

picks.title: Perceptual Color Matching Using LightSpace CMS
picks.description: 最近的 `metamerism`、`making-of` 和 `hdr-color-science` 都在强调一个现实问题：仪器测到同一个白点，不代表不同显示技术在人眼里真的一样。这份 FSI 资料最值得读的地方，是它把 OLED、LCD、投影等设备之间的 observer metamerism 问题，落成了实际校准流程里的判断与取舍，能帮助读者理解为什么“校准正确”与“看起来一致”常常不是同一句话。读完再回头看站内关于窄峰显示、观察者差异和显示白点的章节，会更容易把抽象概念连到真实监看环境。
picks.descriptionEn: The recent `metamerism`, `making-of`, and `hdr-color-science` chapters all keep returning to one production reality: matching a measured white point does not guarantee that different display technologies will look the same to human observers. The value of this FSI resource is that it turns observer metamerism across OLED, LCD, and projection displays into concrete calibration decisions and tradeoffs, which helps explain why "calibrated correctly" and "visually matched" are often not the same statement. It connects the site's recent chapters on narrow-band displays, observer differences, and display white points back to an actual monitoring workflow.

picks.title: Gamut Mapping Part 2: Getting to the Display
picks.description: 站内最近的 `scene-display-referred`、`hdr-color-science` 和 `HDR-Relay` 都在把一个关键点讲透：从场景到显示不是简单缩亮度，而是要一起决定高光颜色、饱和度保留和 path-to-white。这条 ACESCentral 讨论的价值，在于它不只给结论，而是把业内对高亮纯色该保多少、什么时候该更快往白走、不同输出变换想保护什么观感，直接摊开讨论。它很适合作为最近章节里 output transform、chroma compression 和“彩色高光不只是更亮，还要把颜色救回来”的外部续读。
picks.descriptionEn: The recent `scene-display-referred`, `hdr-color-science`, and `HDR-Relay` chapters all make the same core point: going from scene to display is not just about compressing brightness, but about deciding what happens to highlight color, saturation retention, and the path to white. The value of this ACESCentral discussion is that it does not only hand over a result; it exposes the real disagreements about how much bright saturated color should be preserved, when highlights should move toward white more aggressively, and what different output transforms are trying to protect perceptually. It is a strong external continuation of the site's recent discussion of output transforms, chroma compression, and why colored highlights need more than a luminance remap.

picks.title: Deriviation of the ACES White Point
picks.description: 站内最近的 `metamerism`、`scene-display-referred` 和 `hdr-color-science` 都在反复拆一个常见混淆：编码白点、创作白点和显示白点不是同一件事。这页最有价值的地方，不是再报一遍坐标，而是把 ACES 白点为什么常被口头叫成“D60”、它其实并不落在标准 daylight locus 上、以及它为什么只服务于色彩空间转换而不直接规定创作或显示白，讲得很清楚。读完以后，再回头看最近章节里关于 observer difference、白点争议和输出白限制的讨论，会更容易分清哪些是数学参考，哪些才是实际观感与交付判断。
picks.descriptionEn: The site's recent `metamerism`, `scene-display-referred`, and `hdr-color-science` chapters all keep separating one easy confusion: encoding white, creative white, and display white are not the same thing. The value of this page is not another coordinate dump, but how clearly it explains why the ACES white point is often loosely called "D60," why it does not actually sit on the standard daylight locus, and why it exists for color-space conversion rather than directly dictating creative or display white. With that distinction in place, the site's recent discussion of observer differences, white-point debates, and output white limiting becomes much easier to reason about.

picks.title: Chroma Compression
picks.description: 站内最近的 `scene-display-referred` 和 `hdr-color-science` 已经把“同一份 scene-referred 内容到不同显示目标一定要重新渲染”讲出来了；这一页的延伸价值，在于它把高光为什么不能简单往白里裁、为什么亮部和暗部不该用同一种饱和度处理，落成了具体的显示渲染步骤。尤其值得读的是它明确说明：高光会压得更多、纯色会比低饱和色保留得更多、阴影中反而要适度把颜色‘救回来’，这样才能让 HDR 输出既不脏也不发灰。它很适合作为最近章节里 tone mapping / gamut mapping / 输出观感那一段的技术续读。
picks.descriptionEn: The site's recent `scene-display-referred` and `hdr-color-science` chapters already make the point that the same scene-referred content must be re-rendered for different display targets; this page extends that by turning the idea into a concrete rendering step for why highlights should not simply be clipped toward white, and why shadows and highlights should not get the same saturation treatment. The most useful part is how explicitly it states that brighter regions get more compression, purer colors are preserved more than weakly saturated ones, and shadows may need some color brought back so HDR output does not become either dirty or washed out. It works well as a technical continuation of the site's recent tone-mapping, gamut-mapping, and display-rendering discussion.

picks.title: Color matching
picks.description: 站内最近更新的 `metamerism` 和 `making-of`，都在把“颜色其实是对光谱的压缩”讲成一个能建立直觉的问题；这个斯坦福交互页面的价值就在于，它把三刺激匹配、负光和“为什么有些光谱颜色根本不能靠现有三基色正向混出来”直接做成可操作的体验。它值得读，不是因为定义更全，而是因为读者能亲手看到同色异谱、匹配函数和显示色域边界之间的关系，这比只背 XYZ 或 matching functions 更容易真正理解最近章节里的核心论点。
picks.descriptionEn: The site's recently updated `metamerism` and `making-of` chapters both try to turn the idea that color is a compression of spectra into something intuitive, and this Stanford interactive does that by making tristimulus matching, negative light, and the limits of three primaries directly explorable. Its value is not just broader terminology, but letting readers see the relationship between metameric matching, matching functions, and gamut boundaries with their own eyes, which is a much better continuation of the recent chapter's core argument than simply memorizing XYZ or matching-function definitions.

picks.title: White Limiting
picks.description: 站内最近的 `scene-display-referred`、`hdr-color-science` 和 `metamerism` 都把一个容易混淆的点反复讲到位：创作白点、设备白点和输出上限不是同一件事。这篇 ACES 文档最值得读的地方，在于它没有停在抽象“色度变了”，而是直接说明当创作白和设备白不一致时，为什么某个通道会先撞到上限、为什么高光会偏色，以及系统该如何用 white limiting 把这个问题压回可控范围。它很适合把站内关于 display-referred 输出、白点感知和高光保留的讨论继续推进到真实输出变换设计。
picks.descriptionEn: The site's recent `scene-display-referred`, `hdr-color-science`, and `metamerism` chapters all keep returning to one easy-to-mix-up point: creative white, device white, and output limits are not the same thing. The value of this ACES document is that it does not stop at the abstract idea of a chromaticity shift, but directly explains why one channel can hit the ceiling first when creative white and display white differ, why highlights can tint as they clip, and how white limiting keeps that behavior controlled. It is a strong continuation of the site's discussion of display-referred output, white-point perception, and highlight preservation into actual output-transform design.

picks.title: Metamerism Experts’ Day Debrief
picks.description: 站内最近的 `making-of` 和 `metamerism` 都在把“同色异谱不是冷知识，而是后面拍摄、监看、显示问题的起点”讲清楚，这篇业内复盘正好把那条线继续往真实制作现场推进。它最值得读的地方，不是再下定义，而是把 bell pepper 实验、LED 光谱、皮肤反射、相机光谱灵敏度和片场监看连成一条因果链，让人看见为什么同一组白点或同一套色域参数，并不能自动保证人眼、相机和显示器会给出一致结果。
picks.descriptionEn: The site's recent `making-of` and `metamerism` chapters both work to show that metamerism is not trivia but the starting point for later capture, monitoring, and display problems, and this industry debrief pushes that line into real production practice. Its real value is not in redefining the term, but in connecting the bell-pepper experiment, LED spectra, skin reflectance, camera spectral sensitivities, and on-set monitoring into one causal chain, so readers can see why the same white point or gamut specification does not automatically guarantee agreement between the eye, the camera, and the display.

picks.title: Bringing a clearer, more consistent HDR video experience to Chrome
picks.description: 站内最近的 `HDR-Relay`、`hdr-color-science` 和 `scene-display-referred` 都在反复强调：真正麻烦的不是“会不会出 HDR”，而是参考白、headroom 和目标显示如何在播放端被重新解释。这篇新文章的价值就在于它把这些概念落成很具体的显示链路问题：SDR 与 HDR 混排时为什么会互相打架，参考白锚点为什么重要，以及显示 headroom 不够时该怎样保高光而不是把整张图一起冲白。它特别适合作为从站内 203 nit / 输出渲染讨论继续往浏览器与设备适配延伸的一读。
picks.descriptionEn: The site's recent `HDR-Relay`, `hdr-color-science`, and `scene-display-referred` chapters all keep stressing that the hard part is not simply "making HDR," but how reference white, headroom, and the target display get reinterpreted at playback. This recent article is useful because it turns those ideas into concrete display-chain problems: why SDR and HDR can fight each other on the same screen, why a reference-white anchor matters, and how limited display headroom should preserve highlights instead of washing out the whole image. It works especially well as a continuation of the site's 203-nit and output-rendering discussion into browser and device adaptation.

picks.title: Overview of the ACES Encodings
picks.description: 站内最近更新的 `log-gamma` 和 `scene-display-referred` 两章，都在反复强调“Log 不是最终观感，而是中间编码”；这篇官方说明的价值就在于它把 ACES 里几种最容易混淆的编码状态一次拆开：ACES2065-1 为什么偏交换与归档、ACEScg 为什么更适合合成、ACEScct 为什么要给调色师一个更像 Log 的操作手感。它值得读，不是因为术语更全，而是因为它能把“同一条 scene-referred 链路里，不同阶段为什么需要不同编码”讲成一个清晰工作流判断。
picks.descriptionEn: The site's recently updated `log-gamma` and `scene-display-referred` chapters both stress that Log is not the final look but an intermediate encoding, and this official overview is valuable because it cleanly separates the ACES encodings most often confused with one another: why ACES2065-1 is for interchange and archive, why ACEScg better fits compositing, and why ACEScct gives colorists a more Log-like handling feel. Its value is not just broader terminology, but a clearer workflow judgment for why one scene-referred pipeline still needs different encodings at different stages.

picks.title: IPP2 Output Transforms
picks.description: 站内最近更新的 `HDR-Relay`、`hdr-color-science` 和 `scene-display-referred`，都在把“创作在前、显示适配在后”这条边界讲清楚；这份 RED 白皮书的价值，正好是把这件事落成一条很具体的链路：RAW 开发、调色、输出变换各管什么，SDR / HDR 输出为什么不能只靠同一层 LUT 硬套，以及高光 roll-off、色域映射和输出 gamma 为什么应该放在链路末端统一处理。它特别适合读者建立一个更稳的直觉：多格式交付时，真正该保持一致的是场景与风格判断，不是把同一显示变换生搬到所有目标上。
picks.descriptionEn: The site's recently updated `HDR-Relay`, `hdr-color-science`, and `scene-display-referred` chapters all work to clarify the boundary of "create first, adapt for display later," and this RED paper is useful because it turns that idea into a concrete chain: what RAW development, grading, and output transforms each control, why SDR and HDR outputs cannot be forced through the same LUT, and why highlight roll-off, gamut mapping, and output gamma belong together at the end of the pipeline. It is especially good for building the intuition that in multi-format delivery, what should stay consistent is the scene and look decisions, not a single display transform copied onto every target.

picks.title: What Is Metamerism?
picks.description: 站内最近更新的 `making-of` 和 `metamerism` 两页，都把同色异谱放成后面拍摄、后期、显示问题的起点；这篇文章的价值就在于它没有只停在定义，而是把光源、观察者和材料反射谱为什么会让“看起来一样”在换环境后失配，直接讲回打样、校色和实际判断流程。特别值得读的是它把“仪器读数接近”与“肉眼判断一致”明确分开，能帮助读者把同色异谱理解成真实工作流里的检查条件，而不是一个抽象名词。
picks.descriptionEn: The site's recently updated `making-of` and `metamerism` pages both treat metamerism as the starting point for later problems in capture, post, and display, and this article is useful because it goes beyond the definition to explain how illuminants, observers, and material reflectance spectra make a match fall apart when conditions change. The most valuable part is how clearly it separates "instrument readings are close" from "the eye agrees," helping readers treat metamerism as a real workflow condition to check rather than an abstract term.

picks.title: Improving Color on the Web
picks.description: 站内最近更新的 `image-color-management` 章节已经把“RGB 数字不是颜色”和“网页为什么容易翻车”讲到位，这篇 WebKit 长文刚好把那条链路继续补完整：图片嵌入 Profile、浏览器怎样做颜色转换、CSS 颜色默认在什么空间里解释，以及广色域内容为什么必须显式标注与测试。它最值得读的地方，不是单讲 Display P3，而是把网页图像、CSS 颜色和浏览器色彩管理放进同一套系统里解释，特别适合建立从导出到浏览器显示的整体直觉。
picks.descriptionEn: The recently updated `image-color-management` chapter already explains that RGB numbers are not colors and why web images so often go wrong, and this long WebKit piece cleanly extends that chain: embedded profiles, how browsers convert color, what space CSS colors are interpreted in by default, and why wide-gamut content needs explicit tagging and testing. Its value is not just in talking about Display P3, but in putting web images, CSS colors, and browser color management into one system so readers can build a full export-to-browser intuition.

picks.title: Web Sharp Pro v7: Sharing HDR photos made easier
picks.description: 它正好把站内最近更新的 `HDR-Relay` 章节继续往“真正交付给别人”那一步推进：不是只解释 gain map 怎么还原，而是把网页嵌入、浏览器兼容、文件体积、回退 SDR 和在线查看体验放到同一条发布链路里讲。最值得读的是作者如何把 HDR 图片的技术细节转成一套面向实际发布的判断框架，让人更容易建立“做出 HDR 文件”和“让不同设备稳定看到 HDR”之间隔着哪些环节的直觉。
picks.descriptionEn: This is a strong continuation of the site's recently updated `HDR-Relay` chapter into the actual delivery stage: not just how a gain map is reconstructed, but how web embedding, browser compatibility, file size, SDR fallback, and online viewing experience all fit into one publishing chain. The most useful part is how the author turns HDR image technical details into a practical decision framework for publishing, making it much easier to see which workflow steps sit between "making an HDR file" and "having different devices reliably show it as HDR."

picks.title: A photographer's review of the Apple Studio Display XDR
picks.description: 站内最近几章一直在把“参考白”“HDR headroom”和“同色异谱”往显示端现实问题上落，这篇长文正好把几条线接起来：参考模式为什么重要，HDR 屏不是越亮越完事，苹果的 XDR 亮度管理如何影响观感，以及同一目标白点在不同显示技术上为什么仍可能出现主观差异。它的价值不在产品种草，而在让读者看到现代 HDR 监看里“亮度能力、白点感知、使用场景和工作流选择”其实是绑在一起讨论的。
picks.descriptionEn: Several of the site's recent chapters have been pushing reference white, HDR headroom, and metamerism toward real display-side decisions, and this long review ties those threads together well: why reference modes matter, why HDR isn't solved by brightness alone, how Apple's XDR luminance management affects perception, and why the same target white can still look subjectively different across display technologies. Its value is not product promotion, but showing that in modern HDR monitoring, luminance capability, white-point perception, use case, and workflow choice all have to be discussed together.

picks.title: Perceptual Colour Match | Metameric Failure Correction | ColourSpace
picks.description: 它几乎就是站内最近更新的“同色异谱”章节往监看落地再走一步的实操版：为什么仪器已经把白点校到标准值，不同技术路线的显示器还是会看起来不一致。文中最值得读的地方，不是再背一遍 Judd 修正，而是把 RGB OLED、WRGB OLED、激光等窄峰显示上的 observer metamerism 直接转成一套可执行的 perceptual match 流程，并明确区分“测量值正确”和“跨设备看起来一致”不是同一件事。对理解白点争议、Judd-Vos 边界和现代 HDR 监看为什么常要靠视觉匹配，非常有帮助。
picks.descriptionEn: This is almost the practical continuation of the site's recently updated metamerism chapter: why displays can still look different even after instruments say the white point is calibrated correctly. The best part is not rehashing the Judd modification, but turning observer metamerism on narrow-band displays such as RGB OLED, WRGB OLED, and laser systems into an actionable perceptual-match workflow, while clearly separating "the measurement is correct" from "different displays look the same." Very useful for understanding white-point debates, the boundaries of Judd-Vos-style corrections, and why modern HDR monitoring often still depends on visual matching.

picks.title: Resolve Color Management vs ACES—Which Should You Choose?
picks.description: 站内昨天刚把 `log-gamma`、`scene-display-referred` 和 `HDR 色彩科学` 这几条线拉得更紧，这篇文章正好补上“这些概念进到真实调色软件后到底怎么选框架”这一层。它的价值不在替你站队 ACES 或 RCM，而在把输入变换、工作空间、输出变换和监看目标拆开讲清楚，让人看到两套系统其实都在做 scene-to-display 的映射，只是入口、默认假设和可用相机支持不同。对刚建立 scene-referred / display-referred 直觉的读者来说，这比单看参数表更能帮助形成稳定工作流判断。
picks.descriptionEn: The site's recently tightened line between `log-gamma`, `scene-display-referred`, and HDR color science makes this a useful follow-up on what those ideas become inside a real grading system. Its value is not telling you to side with ACES or Resolve Color Management, but clearly separating input transforms, the working space, output transforms, and the monitoring target so you can see that both systems are really doing scene-to-display mapping, only with different entry points, defaults, and camera support. For readers just building intuition around scene-referred versus display-referred workflows, this is much more useful than another parameter sheet.

picks.title: Linear -> PQ luminance mapping in Resolve
picks.description: 它正好把站内最近更新的 HDR Relay 章节里那个最容易被当成“经验参数”的问题讲透了：为什么 scene-referred 线性值进到 PQ / HDR 输出后，不会天然等于你脑中的 203 nit 参考白。Scott Dyer 和 Daniele Siragusano 的回复很有价值，一边给出 ACES 2 在不同峰值亮度下 0.18 灰和 1.0 白分别会落到多少 nit，一边明确指出 BT.2408 的 203 nit 更多是广播兼容语境下的实践锚点，而不是所有电影式输出都必须硬套的绝对答案。对理解“参考白、headroom、输出变换和创作选择不是一回事”非常有帮助。
picks.descriptionEn: This thread nails the issue most easily mistaken for a "rule-of-thumb parameter" in the recently updated HDR Relay chapter: why scene-referred linear values, once pushed into a PQ / HDR output, don't naturally equal the 203-nit reference white you have in mind. Scott Dyer and Daniele Siragusano's replies are valuable — they show what nits 0.18 gray and 1.0 white land on at different peak luminances in ACES 2, while making clear that BT.2408's 203 nits is more a practical anchor for broadcast compatibility than an absolute answer every cinematic output must obey. Great for seeing that reference white, headroom, the output transform, and creative choice are not the same thing.

picks.title: ODTs and the Judd-Vos correction
picks.description: 它正面回答了站内最近更新的同色异谱章节继续往监看工作流追时一定会遇到的问题：OLED 为了更接近人眼感知而做的白点偏移，到底该不该写进 ODT，还是只该留在显示校准层。讨论里最有价值的是几位参与 ACES 输出链路的人把边界讲得很清楚：Judd-Vos 这类修正主要是为了减轻窄峰显示带来的 observer metamerism，它服务的是特定设备的 perceptual match，不应该被烘焙进通用信号本身。对理解“信号正确”和“显示看起来一致”为什么是两件事非常有帮助。
picks.descriptionEn: This thread directly answers a question you're bound to hit as you follow the recently updated metamerism chapter into the monitoring workflow: should an OLED's white-point shift toward perceptual appearance be written into the ODT, or kept only in the display-calibration layer? The most valuable part is how several people involved in the ACES output chain draw the boundary clearly: corrections like Judd-Vos mainly mitigate the observer metamerism caused by narrow-band displays — they serve a device-specific perceptual match and shouldn't be baked into the universal signal itself. Great for understanding why "the signal is correct" and "the display looks consistent" are two different things.

picks.title: How to share HDR photos on Instagram or Threads
picks.description: 它把站内最近更新的 HDR Relay 章节继续往“发布链路”推进了一步：不是只讲增益图怎么合成，而是讲清楚为什么 SDR base 仍然决定大量观众的实际体验。文中最有价值的是它把有限 HDR headroom、平台会不会重生成 SDR、亮度图与全彩 gain map 的差别，以及社交平台上传时哪些步骤会直接破坏 HDR 一次串起来，特别适合建立“做出 HDR 文件”和“让别人稳定看到好 HDR”之间其实隔着一整段工作流的直觉。
picks.descriptionEn: This piece pushes the recently updated HDR Relay chapter one step further into the "delivery pipeline": not just how a gain map is composed, but why the SDR base still decides the actual experience for a large share of viewers. The most valuable part is how it ties together limited HDR headroom, whether a platform re-generates the SDR, the difference between a luminance map and a full-color gain map, and which upload steps outright break HDR — perfect for the intuition that "making an HDR file" and "letting others reliably see good HDR" are separated by a whole workflow.

picks.title: White-OLED/RGB-OLED Perceptual Matching
picks.description: 它没有停留在“同色异谱会导致白点看起来不一样”这类概念说明，而是直接给出一套监看现场会真的用到的匹配流程：先让 RGB OLED 参考监视器到目标，再把 WOLED 通过视觉比对白窗和自定义白点去贴近它。它和站内最近更新的同色异谱章节衔接很强，尤其能帮助读者理解为什么现代 HDR 广色域显示里，仪器测得相同的 D65 仍不等于人眼会觉得一致，以及为什么最后常常需要 perceptual match 而不只是数值 match。
picks.descriptionEn: This piece goes past the conceptual "metamerism makes white points look different" and gives a matching procedure you'd actually use on a monitoring floor: calibrate the RGB OLED reference monitor to target first, then bring the WOLED close via visual comparison of white windows and a custom white point. It connects strongly with the recently updated metamerism chapter, helping you see why, on modern wide-gamut HDR displays, the same measured D65 still doesn't mean the eye agrees — and why a perceptual match, not just a numeric one, is so often needed at the end.

picks.title: Great HDR requires a great SDR in the gain map
picks.description: 它把“增益图不是单独一张 HDR 图，而是 SDR base 加上逐像素恢复信息”讲得非常具体，正好能接上站内最近更新的 HDR Relay 章节。文中最有价值的地方，是它把 fallback SDR、有限 headroom 设备上的混合显示，以及单通道/三通道 gain map 对高光细节和颜色恢复的影响放到同一条发布链路里解释，能帮助读者把“base 决定兜底体验，gain map 决定 HDR 还原质量”真正建立成工作流直觉。
picks.descriptionEn: This piece makes "a gain map isn't a standalone HDR image but an SDR base plus per-pixel recovery information" very concrete, connecting neatly to the recently updated HDR Relay chapter. Its most valuable move is explaining the fallback SDR, mixed display on limited-headroom devices, and how single- vs. three-channel gain maps affect highlight detail and color recovery — all within one delivery pipeline — so you build the workflow intuition that "the base sets the fallback experience, the gain map sets HDR reproduction quality."

picks.title: Using Apple CMF 2026 with Calman
picks.description: 它没有把“白点校准到 D65”当成终点，而是直接解释为什么 OLED、QD-OLED、激光等不同光谱形状的显示器，即使仪器测到同样的 D65，近中性灰和高光仍可能肉眼不匹配。这和站内最近更新的同色异谱章节高度相关，尤其适合把观察者差异、窄峰广色域显示和现代 HDR 监看里的白点争议，从概念进一步落到实际校准与跨设备匹配方法上。
picks.descriptionEn: This piece treats "calibrate the white point to D65" as a starting point rather than the end, explaining why displays with different spectral shapes — OLED, QD-OLED, laser — can still look mismatched in near-neutral grays and highlights even when the instrument reads the same D65. It's highly relevant to the recently updated metamerism chapter, and is especially good for taking observer differences, narrow-band wide-gamut displays, and the white-point debates in modern HDR monitoring from concept down to actual calibration and cross-device matching methods.

picks.title: PQ HDR & HLG
picks.description: 它没有把 PQ、HLG 只讲成两条曲线，而是直接把 HDR 参考白、平均画面亮度和高光余量放到同一套观看逻辑里解释。它能很好补上站内最近更新的 HDR 色彩科学章节里“203 nit 不是最亮白，而是普通白锚点；真正的 HDR 价值主要在参考白以上的 headroom”这层直觉，也顺手解释了为什么 PQ 在家庭环境里常会显得偏暗、为什么 HLG 的相对体系会有不同手感。
picks.descriptionEn: This piece doesn't reduce PQ and HLG to just two curves; it puts HDR reference white, average picture level, and highlight headroom into one viewing logic. It complements the recently updated HDR color science chapter's intuition that "203 nits isn't the brightest white but an ordinary-white anchor, and HDR's real value lies mostly in the headroom above reference white," and along the way explains why PQ often looks dim in a home environment and why HLG's relative system feels different.

picks.title: Common Virtual Production Challenges & Potential Solutions
picks.description: 它把站内最近更新的同色异谱章节进一步落到了 LED 墙实战：当墙面内容肉眼看着正常、相机却拍偏时，问题往往不是“参数没填对”那么简单，而是相机、LED 光谱、白点和现场灯光之间出现了典型的 metameric failure。文中对墙体白点、相机白平衡、相机到 LED 的校准 LUT 以及“要让镜头看对，肉眼可能反而看错”的取舍讲得很具体，特别适合建立现代虚拟制作里的颜色直觉。
picks.descriptionEn: This piece takes the recently updated metamerism chapter further into LED-wall practice: when the wall content looks fine to the eye but the camera records it off, the problem is often not simply "a parameter wasn't set right" but a textbook metameric failure between camera, LED spectrum, white point, and on-set lighting. It's concrete about wall white point, camera white balance, the camera-to-LED calibration LUT, and the trade-off that "to make the lens look right, the eye may have to look wrong" — great for color intuition in modern virtual production.

picks.title: DaVinci Resolve Wide Gamut Intermediate
picks.description: 它不是把 DaVinci Wide Gamut / Intermediate 当成一个“开关”，而是把工作空间、intermediate gamma、中灰位置和可承载的场景范围放在一起解释，能帮助读者把站内最近更新的 Log 章节里“码值分配、中灰锚点、Log 只是场景信息容器”真正连成一条线。对想理解为什么现代调色流程先在更宽的 scene-referred 空间里工作、最后再分别输出 HDR 或 SDR 的读者尤其有用。
picks.descriptionEn: This piece treats DaVinci Wide Gamut / Intermediate as more than a "switch," explaining the working space, intermediate gamma, mid-gray placement, and the scene range it can carry all together — helping you connect the recently updated Log chapter's "code-value allocation, mid-gray anchor, Log as a container for scene information" into one line. Especially useful for understanding why modern grading first works in a wider scene-referred space and only then outputs HDR or SDR separately.

picks.title: Output Transforms
picks.description: 它把 Output Transform 明确拆成 tone scale、chroma compression、gamut compression 和显示编码几个环节，正好对应站内最近更新的 scene/display-referred 与 HDR 色彩科学章节。它的价值不在背术语，而在帮你建立一个更稳的工作流直觉：scene-referred 调色并不是“直接做给屏幕看”，而是先保留场景信息，再由输出变换按目标显示器把参考白、高光余量和颜色边界合理落地。
picks.descriptionEn: This piece clearly breaks the Output Transform into tone scale, chroma compression, gamut compression, and display encoding — matching the recently updated scene/display-referred and HDR color science chapters. Its value isn't memorizing terms but building a steadier workflow intuition: scene-referred grading isn't "working directly for the screen" but preserving scene information first, then letting the output transform reasonably land reference white, highlight headroom, and color boundaries for the target display.

picks.title: WHITE PAPER ON REDWideGamutRGB and Log3G10
picks.description: 它把 Log 不只讲成“平灰画面”，而是直接给出一个很实用的尺度感：18% 中灰为什么落在 1/3，为什么 Log3G10 里的“10”指向中灰以上 10 档，以及这类曲线本来就是为了后续再转成 HDR、SDR 或其他显示编码。它和站内今天更新的 Log 章节衔接很强，尤其适合把“码值分配、中灰锚点、Log 只是承载场景信息而不是最终显示”这三件事一次看顺。
picks.descriptionEn: This piece treats Log as more than a "flat gray image," giving a very practical sense of scale: why 18% mid-gray lands at 1/3, why the "10" in Log3G10 points to 10 stops above gray, and how such curves exist precisely to be converted later into HDR, SDR, or other display encodings. It connects strongly with the recently updated Log chapter, and is ideal for seeing "code-value allocation, the mid-gray anchor, and Log as a carrier of scene information rather than a final display" all at once.

picks.title: Bringing a clearer, more consistent HDR video experience to Chrome
picks.description: 它把 HDR 参考白和 headroom 从标准术语翻成了网页与系统层面真正会遇到的问题：HDR 视频和 SDR 界面混排时，为什么会一起被拉亮、洗白，设备亮度余量不同时又该怎样保住高光。它和站内最近更新的 HDR 色彩科学、HDR Relay 以及 scene/display-referred 章节都能接上，特别适合理解“先固定普通白锚点，再把额外亮度留给 HDR 高光”这条现代显示适配逻辑。
picks.descriptionEn: This piece translates HDR reference white and headroom from standards jargon into the problems you actually hit at the web and system level: when HDR video and SDR UI are mixed, why they get brightened and washed out together, and how to preserve highlights when devices have different headroom. It connects to the recently updated HDR color science, HDR Relay, and scene/display-referred chapters, and is especially good for the modern display-adaptation logic of "anchor ordinary white first, then reserve the extra brightness for HDR highlights."

picks.title: What Is Metamerism?
picks.description: 它把同色异谱拆成 observer、illuminant、geometric、device 几类典型失效，并直接落到多光源检查、统一观察环境和设备一致性这些实务动作上。它和站内最近更新的同色异谱章节衔接很强，尤其适合作为“为什么仪器接近、肉眼仍可能分歧”的工作流延伸阅读。
picks.descriptionEn: This piece breaks metamerism into typical failure types — observer, illuminant, geometric, device — and lands directly on practical actions like multi-illuminant checks, a unified viewing environment, and device consistency. It connects strongly with the recently updated metamerism chapter, and works well as workflow follow-up reading on "why the instrument can be close while the eye still disagrees."

picks.title: Displays & Views
picks.description: 它没有把 scene-referred / display-referred 停留在术语层面，而是直接用 display、view、view transform、display colorspace 解释监看视图背后到底在切什么。更有价值的是，它把 view transform 明确写成 scene 参考空间到 display 参考空间的映射，这对理解站内最近更新章节里 Output Transform、HDR/SDR 视图与最终交付之间的关系非常有帮助。
picks.descriptionEn: This piece doesn't leave scene-referred / display-referred at the term level; it uses display, view, view transform, and display colorspace to explain what a monitoring view is actually switching behind the scenes. More valuably, it states the view transform explicitly as a mapping from the scene reference space to the display reference space — very helpful for understanding the relationship between the Output Transform, HDR/SDR views, and final delivery in the recently updated chapters.

picks.title: Metamerism Experts’ Day Debrief
picks.description: 它不是只给出同色异谱定义，而是把摄影机、LED 光源、激光放映和 QD/OLED 显示里真正会出问题的环节串成了一次行业复盘。它和站内最近更新的同色异谱章节衔接很强，尤其适合读者建立“为什么新显示技术更容易暴露观察者差异与白点失配”这层工作流直觉。
picks.descriptionEn: This piece does more than define metamerism — it strings together where things actually go wrong across cameras, LED sources, laser projection, and QD/OLED displays into an industry debrief. It connects strongly with the recently updated metamerism chapter, and is especially good for the workflow intuition of "why newer display technologies more readily expose observer differences and white-point mismatch."

picks.source: Portrait Displays · HDR 显示与色彩体积
picks.sourceEn: Portrait Displays · HDR display & color volume
picks.title: Why Gamut Rings Is a Better Way to Visualize Display Color
picks.description: 它不是停留在二维色域三角形，而是用更接近实际显示能力的方式解释亮度变化如何改变颜色边界，能直接补上“色域大不等于 HDR 颜色都更丰富”这层直觉。它与站内刚更新的 HDR 色彩科学章节高度相关，尤其适合把色彩体积、峰值亮度和广色域显示之间的关系看得更立体。
picks.descriptionEn: This piece goes beyond the 2D gamut triangle, explaining how luminance changes shift color boundaries in a way closer to real display capability — directly filling in the intuition that "a bigger gamut doesn't mean all HDR colors are richer." It's highly relevant to the recently updated HDR color science chapter, and is especially good for seeing the relationship between color volume, peak luminance, and wide-gamut displays in three dimensions.

picks.source: Frame.io Insider · Gamma / 调色直觉
picks.title: What is Gamma? And How Does a Pro Colorist Use It?
picks.description: 它没有把 gamma 只讲成一个抽象名词，而是直接用波形和调色轮解释：为什么 gamma 主要推动中间调、却能相对钉住黑位和白位，以及它和 offset 在 display-referred 工作里手感为什么完全不同。更重要的是，作者也明确提醒在 color managed 的 scene-referred 流程里不要把 gamma 当万能曝光工具，而应把它当作更细腻的局部明度与色彩平衡手段。
picks.descriptionEn: This piece doesn't leave gamma as an abstract term; it uses the waveform and color wheels to explain why gamma mainly drives the midtones while relatively pinning the black and white points, and why it and offset feel completely different in display-referred work. More importantly, the author clearly warns against treating gamma as an all-purpose exposure tool in a color-managed scene-referred flow, and to use it instead as a finer means of local brightness and color balance.

picks.source: Adobe Blog · HDR 摄影工作流
picks.title: High Dynamic Range - Explained
picks.description: 它把“HDR 比 SDR 多出来的到底是什么”讲得非常落地，不只谈更亮的高光，还强调额外高光余量如何带来更好的色彩分离与层次。更有用的是，作者把实际编辑时最常见的失控点也点出来了，比如 HDR 很容易越调越亮、在单张图上看似没问题但放到相册里会彼此失衡，并给出用白底参考、直方图和 clipping 提示来约束判断的方法。
picks.descriptionEn: This piece grounds "what HDR actually adds over SDR" — not only brighter highlights but how the extra highlight headroom yields better color separation and gradation. More usefully, the author points out the most common ways editing gets out of control, such as HDR creeping ever brighter, or a single image looking fine but unbalanced against others in an album, and offers ways to constrain judgment using a white-background reference, the histogram, and clipping warnings.

picks.source: ACESCentral · ACES / SDR 素材处理
picks.title: How do I apply ACES to SDR images?
picks.description: 它把很多人实际会做、但理论上并不干净的操作摊开说清楚了：当你只有 Rec.709/SDR 成片或板底，却又想放进 ACEScg 里合成时，所谓 inverse ODT 到底是在“补救”什么、又会在哪些高饱和色和高光处变脆。更有价值的是，帖内并没有假装存在完美答案，而是把“临时可用的折中”和“真正正确的 scene-referred 交付”明确区分开，特别适合教学时拿来解释工作流边界。
picks.descriptionEn: This thread lays out an operation many people actually do but which isn't theoretically clean: when you only have a Rec.709/SDR cut or plate yet want to composite it in ACEScg, what an inverse ODT is really "patching," and where it gets brittle in highly saturated colors and highlights. More valuably, it doesn't pretend a perfect answer exists, but clearly separates a "temporary usable compromise" from a "truly correct scene-referred delivery" — great for explaining workflow boundaries when teaching.

picks.title: HDR: gain maps vs tone mapping
picks.description: 它没有把 Web HDR 讲成格式清单，而是直接回答一个实际问题：为什么单纯丢一张 HDR 图给浏览器做自动 tone mapping，往往不等于创作者想让 SDR 用户看到的版本。文章把 gain map 解释成“同时照顾 HDR 与 SDR 观看体验的交付策略”，并进一步说明它为什么比仅靠更高位深更关键。对理解网页广色域/HDR 发布链路非常有帮助。
picks.descriptionEn: The best part of this piece is that it doesn't present Web HDR as a format checklist, but answers a practical question: why simply handing the browser an HDR image for automatic tone mapping often isn't the version the creator wants SDR users to see. It explains the gain map as "a delivery strategy that serves both the HDR and SDR viewing experience" and why that matters more than just higher bit depth. Very helpful for understanding the web wide-gamut / HDR publishing pipeline.

picks.title: Know When to Log ’em, Know When to Lin ’em
picks.description: 它没有把“线性更物理、log 更平”停留在口号层面，而是直接把常见操作拆开来看：模糊、叠加、光效、缩放为什么更适合在线性里做，压黑、反相、某些感知型锐化和胶片式处理为什么反而更像是在 log 或 video 空间里工作。对正在搭建 HDR/VFX/调色整体直觉的读者，它能帮助你把“数学正确”和“观感正确”区分开。
picks.descriptionEn: The best part of this piece is that it doesn't leave "linear is more physical, log is flatter" as a slogan, but breaks down common operations: why blur, compositing, light effects, and scaling are better done in linear, while crushing blacks, inverting, certain perceptual sharpening, and film-like processing feel more at home in log or video space. For anyone building overall HDR/VFX/grading intuition, it helps separate "mathematically correct" from "perceptually correct."

picks.title: What's the correct way to composit with ACES, considering the difference in white values?
picks.description: 这条讨论非常适合建立 scene-referred 的真实尺度感。回复没有停在“ACES 里 1.0 不是显示白”这种抽象说法，而是进一步把 1.0 解释成接近场景里的漫反射白，并说明为什么你在 Rec.709 里觉得应该炸掉的元素，放进 ACES/HDR 后往往只会显得发灰或半透明。它能把很多人第一次做字幕、图形、光效或发光元素时的困惑讲透。
picks.descriptionEn: This thread is excellent for building a real sense of scene-referred scale. The replies don't stop at the abstract "1.0 in ACES isn't display white" — they go further to explain 1.0 as close to diffuse white in the scene, and why elements you'd expect to blow out in Rec.709 often just look grey or semi-transparent once placed in ACES/HDR. It clears up the confusion many hit the first time they add titles, graphics, light effects, or glowing elements.

picks.title: Log C
picks.description: 它把很多人日常在用、却常常只停留在“平灰画面”印象里的 Log 重新讲回到底层：为什么它按曝光档位编码、为什么更适合承载场景信息、以及为什么最终一定还要经过显示变换。文中还顺手把 LogC3 与 LogC4 的差异、混用限制和 SDR/HDR/P3 输出关系串起来，非常适合建立摄影机编码与后期显示之间的整体直觉。
picks.descriptionEn: This piece takes Log — something many use daily but often picture only as a "flat gray image" — back to fundamentals: why it encodes by exposure stop, why it better carries scene information, and why it must always pass through a display transform in the end. It also ties together the differences between LogC3 and LogC4, the limits of mixing them, and their relationship to SDR/HDR/P3 output — great for the overall intuition linking camera encoding to display in post.

picks.title: Use same LUT for HDR/SDR
picks.description: 这条讨论的价值在于它直接击中真实项目里最常见的误区之一：在 HDR 里做好的创意 LUT，为什么一套到 SDR 就会炸高光。回复不仅指出 ACEScc 不是理想交换格式，还把“灰卡应留在什么场景值附近”“HDR 监看为什么会诱导你把整体推得过亮”这些判断讲得很具体，能帮助读者理解创意调整、工作空间和输出变换不能混成一件事。
picks.descriptionEn: This thread hits one of the most common misconceptions in real projects: why a creative LUT built in HDR blows out the highlights the moment it's applied to SDR. The replies note that ACEScc isn't an ideal interchange format, and get concrete about "what scene value the gray card should sit near" and "why HDR monitoring tempts you to push the overall level too bright" — helping you see that creative adjustments, the working space, and the output transform can't be lumped into one thing.

picks.title: Understanding the sRGB RRT/ODT
picks.description: 它把很多人刚接触 ACES 时最困惑的问题讲透了：为什么场景里 1.0 的白不会直接显示成屏幕上的 1.0 白，以及“高于白”的高光到底被放到哪里。Scott Dyer 用非常具体的数值把 scene-referred 到 display-referred 的映射解释清楚，能帮助读者真正建立对 RRT/ODT、highlight headroom 和 HDR 余量的直觉。
picks.descriptionEn: it clears up the question that most confuses ACES newcomers: why a scene 1.0 white doesn't display directly as 1.0 white on screen, and where "above-white" highlights actually go. Scott Dyer uses very concrete numbers to explain the scene-referred to display-referred mapping, helping you build real intuition for the RRT/ODT, highlight headroom, and HDR headroom.

picks.source: Chrome for Developers · Web 广色域
picks.sourceEn: Chrome for Developers · web wide gamut
picks.title: High definition CSS color guide
picks.description: 这篇文章的价值不只是告诉你 CSS Color 4 有哪些新语法，而是把“为什么网页长期停留在 sRGB 逻辑里、而现代显示设备早已进入广色域”这件事讲得很清楚。它用具体示例解释 Display-P3、Rec.2020、渐变混色和感知亮度差异，特别适合把影视里的广色域认知延伸到 Web 图像与界面呈现工作流。
picks.descriptionEn: The value of this article isn't only telling you what new syntax CSS Color 4 has, but clearly explaining why the web stayed on sRGB logic for so long while modern display devices moved to wide gamut years ago. With concrete examples it covers Display-P3, Rec.2020, gradient interpolation, and perceptual-brightness differences — great for extending wide-gamut understanding from film/TV into the web image and UI presentation workflow.

picks.title: When Should You Color Grade in Log vs. Linear?
picks.description: 它没有把“log 和 linear 的区别”停留在定义层面，而是直接拿曝光、对比和白平衡调整做对照，说明为什么有些操作在 linear 里更接近物理曝光、在 log 里却容易引入补偿动作。对正在建立 HDR/scene-referred 工作流直觉的人，它能把工具手感和底层响应方式真正连起来。
picks.descriptionEn: The best part of this piece is that it doesn't leave "the difference between log and linear" at the definition level, but directly contrasts exposure, contrast, and white-balance adjustments to show why some operations are closer to physical exposure in linear yet easily introduce compensating moves in log. For anyone building HDR/scene-referred workflow intuition, it genuinely connects how a tool feels to how the underlying response behaves.

picks.title: ACES and the ColorChecker - Part One
picks.description: 这条内容的价值在于它把片场里常被想得过于简单的事情摊开了讲：ColorChecker、HDRI、实拍板和 ACES 里的 IDT/线性化并不会天然完美对齐。讨论区里不仅有作者的实际做法，还有 Thomas Mansencal 等人对拍摄角度、反射误差、HDRI 编码和素材限制的补充，特别适合读者看到“标准流程”背后的现实偏差与判断方法。
picks.descriptionEn: The value here is that it lays out something often oversimplified on set: ColorChecker, HDRI, live-action plates, and the IDT/linearization in ACES don't naturally line up perfectly. The thread has not only the author's actual practice but additions from Thomas Mansencal and others on shooting angle, reflection error, HDRI encoding, and footage limitations — great for seeing the real-world deviations behind a "standard procedure" and how to judge them.

picks.title: Illustrate a metameric matching and chromatic aberration
picks.description: 这篇内容很适合用来建立“同色异谱”的核心直觉：两条光谱可以完全不同，但只要对人眼三类视锥产生相同刺激，就会看起来一样。它不仅解释概念，还展开了 D65 光谱如何被 LCD 三基色配成视觉等效结果，能帮助理解显示、摄影机和色彩管理为什么都受光谱压缩限制。
picks.descriptionEn: This is great for building the core intuition of metamerism: two spectra can be completely different yet look the same as long as they produce the same stimulus in the eye's three cone types. It not only explains the concept but works through how the D65 spectrum is matched to a visually equivalent result by an LCD's three primaries — helping you understand why displays, cameras, and color management are all limited by spectral compression.

picks.title: Perceptual Colour Match | Metameric Failure Correction | ColourSpace
picks.description: 如果你已经知道同色异谱的定义，这篇更进一步解释它为什么会在 RGB OLED、激光和窄带广色域显示器上变成实际问题。文章把“仪器读数一致但肉眼不一致”的校准困境讲得很具体，并给出基于视觉比对的工作流，能帮助读者理解观察者同色异谱误差为什么会影响监看一致性。
picks.descriptionEn: If you already know the definition of metamerism, this goes further to explain why it becomes a real problem on RGB OLED, laser, and narrow-band wide-gamut displays. It gets concrete about the calibration dilemma of "the instrument reads the same but the eye doesn't agree," and offers a visual-comparison workflow that helps you understand why observer-metamerism error affects monitoring consistency.

picks.title: How to Color Manage using Nodes in DaVinci Resolve
picks.description: 这篇教程的价值在于它没有把色彩管理讲成抽象术语，而是直接用 Resolve 的 Group Pre-Clip、Timeline 和 CST 节点把“相机空间、工作空间、显示空间”三层关系拆开。对刚接触 Log、RAW、跨机型混剪的人来说，很适合建立从素材进入到监看输出的实际工作流直觉。
picks.descriptionEn: The value of this tutorial is that it doesn't present color management as abstract terminology, but uses Resolve's Group Pre-Clip, Timeline, and CST nodes to break apart the three-layer relationship of camera space, working space, and display space. For anyone new to Log, RAW, or mixing across camera models, it's great for building practical workflow intuition from footage ingest to monitoring output.

picks.title: DI Delivering HDR, VFX monitoring SDR
picks.description: 这串讨论特别适合教学，因为它不只是给一个标准答案，而是把真实协作中的冲突摆到台面上：当 DI 在 1000 nit HDR 监看、VFX 却只有 SDR 显示器时，到底该统一 ODT 还是各看各的显示条件。你能从中看到 ACES 社区成员对“统一观看模型”与“按显示设备匹配输出”的不同立场。
picks.descriptionEn: This thread is especially good for teaching because it doesn't just give one standard answer — it puts a real collaboration conflict on the table: when DI monitors in 1000-nit HDR but VFX only has an SDR display, should the ODT be unified or should each side use its own display conditions? You can see ACES community members' differing stances on a "unified viewing model" versus "matching output per display device."

picks.title: ARRI REVEAL Color Science Explained
picks.description: 把 REVEAL、AWG4、LogC4 和 LUT 兼容性问题放进同一条叙事线里，能帮助你把“新色彩科学为什么会改工作流”这件事真正串起来，尤其适合建立从拍摄到调色的整体直觉。
picks.descriptionEn: Putting REVEAL, AWG4, LogC4, and LUT-compatibility issues into one narrative helps you connect why "new color science changes the workflow" — especially good for building overall intuition from shooting to grading.

picks.source: ACESCentral · 图形与字幕工作流
picks.title: Preserving Logos and Graphics in ACES
picks.description: 这串讨论集中分析了 ACES 中常见的一类问题：为什么 logo、字幕和 UI 资产进入 scene-referred 流程后外观会改变。它的价值不在结论统一，而在于能让你看到 display-referred 元素该放在工作流哪一层。
picks.descriptionEn: This thread focuses on a common ACES problem: why logos, titles, and UI assets change appearance once they enter a scene-referred flow. Its value isn't a unified conclusion but seeing which layer of the workflow display-referred elements belong in.

picks.title: Introduction to HDR - by Kevin Shaw, C.S.I
picks.description: 从调色师视角解释 HDR 制作为什么需要新的工作流，并把 ACES、HDR 监看和创作判断放在同一个语境里，适合作为 HDR 章节的延伸阅读。
picks.descriptionEn: From a colorist's viewpoint, this explains why HDR production needs a new workflow and places ACES, HDR monitoring, and creative judgment in one context — good as follow-up reading for the HDR chapter.

picks.title: Wide Gamut Color in CSS with Display-P3
picks.description: 以网页开发者能理解的方式讲清楚为什么 sRGB 不再覆盖所有屏幕颜色，以及如何在 CSS 中使用 Display-P3，很适合补充图片色彩管理章节。
picks.descriptionEn: In terms a web developer can follow, this explains why sRGB no longer covers all screen colors and how to use Display-P3 in CSS — a good supplement to the image color-management chapter.
